item.title: Substantial amount of waste on the road, 15th November
item.description:
I am writing to formally report an incident of illegal fly-tipping at the end of Braywood Road, Bexley (Falconwood), close to my residential property and directly beside my parked vehicle. A substantial amount of waste has been dumped on the road, including what appears to be building insulation, household rubbish, plastic bags and a broken electrical fan. The waste is occupying part of a residential parking area and has been left extremely close to my vehicle. I am concerned about the potential safety hazards, the obstruction caused and the possibility of further dumping if this is not addressed promptly. I have attached photographs and video footage showing the location, the extent of the rubbish and its proximity to my vehicle. I would like to formally request: 1. Urgent removal of the illegally dumped waste from the road and parking area. 2. An investigation by the council’s Environmental Crime Team to identify those responsible. 3. Consideration of any available CCTV footage from the surrounding area, along with any evidence found within the dumped waste. 4. Appropriate enforcement action against those responsible, should sufficient evidence be obtained. 5. Confirmation that my report has been registered, together with a reference number and an update on the proposed removal. I would appreciate this matter being treated as a priority, particularly because of the proximity to residential properties and parked vehicles. Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 58, Braywood Road, Falconwood, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
